/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'ROL_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'MAINROLE_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_1');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_1_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_1_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_1_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_1.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_SYSOBJ_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز التطبيق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_2');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_2_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_2_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_2_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_2.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_SYSOBJ_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز القوائم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_3');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_3_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_3_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_3_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_3.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_SYSOBJ_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز القائمة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_4');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_4_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_4_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_4_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_4.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_SYSOBJ_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الشاشة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_41');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_41_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_41_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_41_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_41.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_SYSOBJ_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز النظام' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الانظمة','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_5');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_5_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_5_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$SC1520_CENTER_GLOBALS.SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_5_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SC_SYSOBJ_ROL_5.SYS_ANAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(SYS_ANAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((SYSOBJ_ID) IN '||'(SELECT SYSOBJ_ID '||'FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SDRP_ROL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDRP_RDO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الحقل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الجداول','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'صلاحيات على الجداول','الادوار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'ROL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الصلاحية' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الصلاحية,رمز التطبيق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSOBJ_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز النظام' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSROLPRV_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الصلاحية,رمز القوائم' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SYSOBJ_PK') THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN

 END IF;
 END IF;

Trigger.Name: ON-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_ROLE VARCHAR2(30);
 V_DBOBJ VARCHAR2(30);
 V_S NUMBER;
 V_I NUMBER;
 V_U NUMBER;
 V_D NUMBER ;
 V_DBJ_NO NUMBER;



CURSOR ROLE_DATA IS
 SELECT RUS.DBOBJ_NO,DAT.DBOBJ_ENAME, RUS.RL_db_select,rus.RL_db_insert,
 rus.RL_db_UPDATE, rus.RL_db_DELETE
 FROM RG_DATABASE_OBJECTS DAT, sc_dbobj_ROLE_privs RUS
 WHERE ROLE_ID = :ROL.ROLE_ID2 AND
 RUS.DBOBJ_NO = DAT.DBOBJ_NO AND
 RUS.DBOBJ_NO <> 1 ;
BEGIN
 OPEN ROLE_DATA ;
 LOOP

 FETCH ROLE_DATA INTO V_DBJ_NO,V_DBOBJ,V_S,V_I,V_U,V_D;

 GRANT_ROLE_PRIVS(:ROL.ROLE_ID2,V_DBOBJ,V_S,V_I,V_U,V_D);
 EXIT WHEN ROLE_DATA%NOTFOUND;
 END LOOP;
CLOSE ROLE_DATA;
 END;
COMMIT;
